title: Data Analyst (No Experience Required)
description:
For thousands of years, maps have provided humans with the knowledge they need to make decisions. As a Maps Evaluator, you will have the opportunity to provide ground truth for your town, city or country.

 

At Peroptyx, we are looking for Data Analysts who will review mapping data for digital mapping applications. Your research capabilities will validate and ensure that the navigation of certain routes are accurate and safe.

 

As part of this role you will verify that business names and opening hours are correct. You will check that the distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately, resulting in better user experiences.

 

With this job you can plan your days around this highly flexible working schedule, work weekends or late evenings, all from the comfort of your own office. The flexibility of our roles minimizes the impact on your daily routine.

 

So, whether you are a student looking to earn as you learn, a retiree looking for a new challenge, a part-time/full time professional or a work from home parent, Peroptyx has the right role for you!

 

Benefits

  • Work up to 20 hours per week.

  • Earn a competitive rate of pay.

  • Develop your research skills.

  • Avoid the long commute.

  • Work from the comfort of your home office.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of setting your own working hours!

 

Ideal Candidate

  • Fluent in English

  • Excellent research skills.

  • Excellent local knowledge of your home country.

  • Good understanding and general knowledge of the geography and culture of Canada.

  • Analytical mindset.

 

Job Requirements

  • Must be living in Canada for a minimum of 5 consecutive years.

  • Must pass an online open-book exam that can verify your full understanding of the material and concepts.

  • Must be willing to work a minimum of 10 hours and up to 20 hours per week depending on task availability.

  • Good working knowledge of search engines, map applications and familiarity with social media platforms.

  • Strong ability to learn, understand and apply multiple sets of different instructions.

  • All work must be of an independent nature.

 

Apply Online Today!

title: QA Testers Wanted to Jump on an AI Assistant project
description:
About Tester Work

Tester Work is a global QA crowdsourcing platform that connects companies building digital products with a community of freelance testers worldwide. We help businesses improve their websites, mobile apps, and software by enabling real users to test products in real-world conditions and provide structured feedback.

As a tester, you’ll get access to flexible, project-based opportunities where you can earn money by executing test cases, exploring applications, and sharing usability feedback that helps improve digital products.

 

Overview

We are currently looking for QA testers to join our testing community. Once onboarded, you will gain access to our latest project and you'll be able to help us fine-tune a personal AI assistant developed by one of the biggest tech companies on the market. Besides, a variety of projects across different industries, including e-commerce, fintech, entertainment, and mobile applications, will also be available for you.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Follow step-by-step test cases to validate user flows (e.g., sign-up, login, checkout, payments)
  • Explore apps and websites to identify bugs or usability issues
  • Submit clear bug reports with steps, screenshots, or recordings when needed
  • Test region-specific features and localized functionality when required

 

Who This Role Is For

Based in one of the following countries:

  1. Switzerland (French and German speakers)
  2. Sweden (Native Swedish speakers)
  3. Luxembourg (English speakers)
  4. Belgium (Dutch and French speakers)
  5. Denmark (Native Danish speakers)
  6. Norway (Native Norwegian speakers)
  7. Finland (Native Finnish speakers)
  8. Saudi Arabia (Native Arabic speakers)
  9. Israel (Native Hebrew speakers)
  • Comfortable using websites, mobile apps and AI
  • QA/testing experience is a plus, but not required

 

What You Can Expect

  • Fully remote, flexible, project-based work
  • No fixed schedule, choose tasks based on your availability
  • Exposure to a wide range of digital products and industries
  • Opportunity to build QA/testing experience over time
  • Ongoing access to new testing cycles once onboarded

 

Compensation

  • Payment varies depending on project scope and complexity
  • Each assignment clearly defines tasks and compensation upfront
  • All payments are processed securely via PayPal, Wise or Upwork 

 

If you enjoy exploring apps, identifying issues, and helping improve digital products, this is a great opportunity to gain experience and earn flexible income as part of a global testing community.
location: Switzerland, Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Saudi Arabia and Israel

title: AI Content Reviewer, Video Annotation
description:
100% Remote | Independent Contractor | 35 - 40 USD/hour

Help shape the future of AI.

Artificial Intelligence is evolving rapidly, and high-quality data plays a key role in making it smarter. We're looking for detail-oriented individuals to contribute to exciting AI projects by reviewing and annotating video content.

This is your opportunity to get involved in the world of AI, gain hands-on experience, and contribute to technologies shaping the future.

No previous AI or robotics experience required!

What you'll do

What we're looking for

  • Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking.

  • Good written English and ability to follow instructions.

  • Reliability and ability to work independently.

  • No previous AI, robotics, or annotation experience needed.

Why join?

  • Earn  35 - 40 USD/hour, depending on your country.

  • Work remotely from your location.

  • Gain hands-on experience supporting AI development.

  • Contribute to projects at the forefront of technology.

Get started

We currently have three projects open! Complete our certification process to demonstrate your skills and be considered for the opportunity that best matches your profile.

Your attention to detail could help shape what's next in AI!

This is an independent contractor opportunity. Project assignment and work availability are subject to certification results and project requirements.

title: Video Creator (100% remote)
description:
Make videos about brands you love and get paid, no followers required!

We're Marker Video, and we'd love for you to join our platform!👋

Sign up (it's free) and create videos about brands you love across beauty, food & drink, lifestyle, fitness, and travel.

Brands actively buying videos from their real customers (that's you) on Marker include: HelloFresh, Ollie Pets, Camile Thai, Spencer's Gifts and lots more. 

Create videos in your own tone of voice and style with no briefs or scripts from the brands. Authenticity and videos filled with your unique perspective are what brands need and want.

Videos can be reviews, tutorials, first impressions, unboxing videos, vlogs, etc. Just keep them to 30 seconds or less! 

Once your video has been uploaded to Marker, we'll notify the brand, and they can buy and use it for their marketing. 

You’ll get paid $100 for each video you successfully sell, and you can submit as many videos as you like (the more you upload, the more you can earn). 

To sign up, ensure you are: 

  • Based only in the USA, Canada, Ireland or the UK (although you submit videos remotely, we are only Stripe-enabled in select territories, so if you sign up from elsewhere, we won't be able to verify or pay you).

  • Comfortable in front of the camera

  • Fluent in spoken & written English

  • A strong, confident storyteller 

  • Competent in recording, editing and uploading videos for socials 

  • Seriously interested in TikTok & Instagram

  • Passionate about brands and products, and the content on their social channels 

Note that this is not a full-time role. Upload videos as and when you choose, and you’ll be paid for each video you sell on Marker.

Please register via the provided link ONLY; note that any applicants who email us to apply will not be registered on our system.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 
Team Marker
location: USA, Canada, Ireland and UK ONLY

title: Remote Customer Service Representative - Independent Contractor
description:

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).

  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
